title: TonalEnergy Tuning Log Failure Rate
dataSources: Yousician lessons (`yousician:lesson`), Simply Piano practice (`simplypiano:session`), TonalEnergy tuning (`tonalenergy:tuning`), Pro Metronome sessions (`prometronome:session`), and forScore practice (`forscore:practice`).
app: Yousician lessons, Simply Piano practice, TonalEnergy tuning logs, Pro Metronome sessions, and forScore sheet-music practice exports ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tonalenergy:tuning
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(tuning_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by instrument_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often TonalEnergy tuning log records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each instrument name.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize tuning_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per instrument name.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals which parts of your TonalEnergy tuning log data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
